user.title: Connect to Rusty
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your Rusty device. Leave the password blank if none is set.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered Rusty device
zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to add the Rusty device named `{name}` to Home Assistant?

rediscovery_confirm.title: Rusty device moved
rediscovery_confirm.description: The Rusty device `{name}` was found at a new address (`{host}`), previously at `{old_host}`. Enter the API password to verify the device's identity, then confirm to update the stored address.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Rusty
reauth_confirm.description: The password for Rusty at `{host}` was rejected. Enter the current API password.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Speaks text on a Rusty device using on-device text-to-speech. Select the target device using the device picker.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Rusty device to speak on.
